Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I was looking at the Gold's Gym Bangladesh packages page — Silver at ৳99K/year, Gold at ৳137.5K with spa & pool — and the Bashundhara Group backing is a strong signal. You're sitting in a premium tier where every member is a 5-figure annual commitment.

The thing that jumped out: intake is phone-only on the Bashundhara City + Residential locations. A prospect messaging you at 10pm after the gym isn't going to call — they're going to Axiom's Instagram DM. For a BDT 99K-2.5L package, every after-hours enquiry that goes to a competitor is a real cost.

I built an AI membership agent that answers pricing/class/women-only questions on Instagram + WhatsApp + your site, qualifies goals (weight loss vs strength vs general fitness), books a free trial session into your trainers' calendars, and sends automated renewal reminders 30/15/7 days before expiry so members never lapse unnoticed.

I've built a working demo using your actual package structure — happy to show you in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
